title: Sewage Treatment Plant Effluent Reshapes the Gut Microbiome of Wild Brown Trout in a Headwater Stream
description: This study investigated the effects of sewage treatment plant (STP) effluent on the gut microbiome of wild brown trout (Salmo trutta m. fario L). Trout were sampled 0, 6, 14, and 24 weeks after restocking at sites upstream and downstream of an STP discharge. Gut-content DNA was extracted and analysed by 16S rRNA metagenomic sequencing to characterise the taxonomic composition, diversity, and functional potential of the bacterial community.
